name: Takamizo Hachisuke
source:
Hachisuke, otherwise known simply as Hachi, is one of [url=/c10382]Yuuma[/url]'s close friends and hangs out with him and [url=/c2]Jun Watarase[/url] constantly. He seems to be desperate for any affection from girls, as the closest chance he has at getting a girl is with his friend Jun, who, despite his feminine appearance, is in fact male. He is often very perverted as well. 

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Happiness!#Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
